purpose.zh: 用器械稳定加重量，练臀部侧面开腿的力量和耐力
purpose.en: Use the machine to load the sides of your hips for leg-opening strength and endurance.

text.zh: 靠稳椅背，膝盖外侧把垫子推开
text.en: Sit back against the pad and push the pads out with your outer knees

text.zh: 推到最开停1秒，再慢慢收回。
text.en: Pause for one second at the widest point, then return slowly.

text.zh: 双手扶住把手，身体不前后晃。
text.en: Hold the handles and keep your body from rocking.

commonErrors.en: Letting the weight slam back on the return.

cautions.zh: 髋部疼时减轻重量或推小一点，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your hips hurt, use less weight or move less far, and stop if it still hurts.

changes: 名字含「髋外展 / Hip Abduction」，改「坐姿器械开腿 / Seated Machine Leg Opener」
cue2「慢回 3 秒」与动画（约 1.2 s 收回）不符，改「慢慢收回」
用户已定：改名、计时/计次、每侧/起始侧、计数单位按最终口径处理，相关待定项清除
最终口径：按真实做法定（2026-11-01）
